question: Which deity is present to the north of the sacred field of Kālī?
premises: The field of Kālī has a northern region.
Janārdana, god of gods, is located there.
inference: Janārdana, the god of gods, is in the north of the Kālī field.
plain_english: To the north of the field of Kālī is Janārdana, the god of gods.
